expression: The bicycles park on the upper side of the image near the green space.
normalised: from top {upper} side from bottom {near} green space
program:
def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    bicycle_patches = image_patch.find("bicycle")
    green_space_patches = image_patch.find("green space")

    if not bicycle_patches or not green_space_patches:
        return []

    upper_green_space = min(green_space_patches, key=lambda g: g.vertical_center)

    near_bicycles = [b for b in bicycle_patches if abs(b.vertical_center - upper_green_space.vertical_center) < 50]

    return near_bicycles
